title: Which killed more in the 20th century: smallpox or the World Wars?
subtitle: Pick the bigger killer, smallpox or the two World Wars, then see the gap drawn to scale, and how a vaccine wiped smallpox out for good.
notes: Fix round: one compare pair (Both World Wars 95 vs Smallpox 300) with a 'Smallpox!' reveal stamp; dashed cuts at 95 and 190 with '×3' show smallpox = three times both wars; hand-drawn timeline 1796 vaccine / 1967 final push / 1977 last case / 1980 gone; no ellipse. b guesses right (the trick question) and supplies the dollar-a-life kicker.
